column1: # The pristine transcription: the Haskell code of the Haskell 2010 Report's Prelude and of the library modules it
# prints code for, taken from the Report's sources, github.com/haskell/haskell-report, at commit
# 15bff260ba78a27aae140ced0dedea4bc094cd33 (2010-07-20 12:11:30 UTC), the commit the online Report of 2010-07-20 was
# made from. The Prelude's four modules are the sources' report/<module>.hs, byte for byte; each of the four library
# modules is the code block of its chapter's Specification section in report/libs/<Module>.tex, each line without the
# one leading space every line of it has there, nothing else changed (the code the haskell2010 package's $code
# comments hold too). Never edit these files: they are what overlay.tsv is held to.
# Columns: file, module, section (the 2010 Report's), source (its path at the commit, and for a chapter the lines of
# the code block), blob (git's id of that path at the commit), lines, sha256 (the file).
